title: 第11课 · 他比我大三岁
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 11 — 他比我大三岁 · He is three years older than me

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在歌厅 — In a karaoke bar

items.zh: A：王方，昨天和你一起唱歌的人是谁？
items.py: A: Wáng Fāng, zuótiān hé nǐ yìqǐ chàng gē de rén shì shéi?
items.en: A: Wang Fang, who was singing with you yesterday?

items.py: B: Yí ge péngyou.
items.en: B: A friend.

items.zh: A：什么朋友？是不是男朋友？
items.py: A: Shénme péngyou? Shì bu shì nánpéngyou?
items.en: A: What kind of friend? A boyfriend?

items.zh: B：不是不是，我同学介绍的，昨天第一次见。
items.py: B: Bú shì bú shì, wǒ tóngxué jièshào de, zuótiān dì yī cì jiàn.
items.en: B: No, no. A classmate introduced us — we met for the first time yesterday.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在宿舍 — In the dorm

items.zh: A：左边这个看报纸的女孩子是你姐姐吗？
items.py: A: Zuǒbian zhège kàn bàozhǐ de nǚ háizi shì nǐ jiějie ma?
items.en: A: Is the girl on the left reading the paper your elder sister?

items.zh: B：是，右边写字的那个人是我哥哥。
items.py: B: Shì, yòubian xiě zì de nàge rén shì wǒ gēge.
items.en: B: Yes, and the one on the right writing is my elder brother.

items.py: A: Nǐ gēge duō dà?
items.en: A: How old is your brother?

items.py: B: Èrshíwǔ suì, tā bǐ wǒ dà sān suì.
items.en: B: 25. He's three years older than me.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在商店 — At a store

items.py: A: Jīntiān de xīguā zěnme mài?
items.en: A: How much are the watermelons today?

items.py: B: Sān kuài wǔ yì jīn.
items.en: B: Three fifty a jin (500 g).

items.py: A: Bǐ zuótiān piányi.
items.en: A: Cheaper than yesterday.

items.zh: B：是，苹果也比昨天便宜一些。您来点儿吧。
items.py: B: Shì, píngguǒ yě bǐ zuótiān piányi yìxiē. Nín lái diǎnr ba.
items.en: B: Yes, apples are a bit cheaper too. Why not take some?

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在学校 — In the school

items.zh: A：前边说话的那个人就是我的汉语老师。你可能不认识她。
items.py: A: Qiánbian shuō huà de nàge rén jiù shì wǒ de Hànyǔ lǎoshī. Nǐ kěnéng bú rènshi tā.
items.en: A: The woman talking in front is my Chinese teacher. You may not know her.

items.py: B: Shì xīn lái de Hànyǔ lǎoshī ma?
items.en: B: Is she the new Chinese teacher?

items.py: A: Shì qùnián lái de, tā xìng Wáng, èrshíbā suì.
items.en: A: She came last year. Her surname is Wang, she's 28.

items.py: B: Tā bǐ wǒmen lǎoshī xiǎo liǎng suì.
items.en: B: She's two years younger than our teacher.
